item.title: The Right Fit: Contract Work Finds Increasing Favor Among Employers, Professionals
item.description: Contract work opportunities have grown year over year, and recent reports show more people are in this type of role, according to BioSpace data. Three biopharma professionals share why they’ve become contractors and discuss the pros and cons.

item.title: 10 Companies Hiring in San Francisco and South San Francisco
item.description: Looking for a biopharma job in San Francisco or South San Francisco? Check out the BioSpace list of 10 companies hiring life sciences professionals like you.

item.title: BioAtla Axes 70% of Staff, Explores Strategic Options
item.description: Less than a year after cutting roughly 30% of its employees, BioAtla is letting go of an even larger chunk of its workforce as it considers its future, which could include strategic partnerships and selling off assets.

item.title: The Job Market May Be Warming—What Does That Mean for You?
item.description: Employees are reassessing, leaders are celebrating data that should make them nervous and job seekers are absorbing a narrative that doesn’t match their reality. Executive coach Angela Justice discusses how each of these groups are affected when the job market thaws.

item.title: The Top 12 Companies Hiring in Biopharma Now
item.description: Looking for a biopharma job? Check out the BioSpace list of 12 top companies hiring life sciences professionals like you.

item.title: Keeping the Door Open: Many Would Return to Companies That Laid Them Off
item.description: Over half of biopharma professionals would work again at the companies that let them go, according to a BioSpace LinkedIn poll. Several professionals, as well as recruiting and talent acquisition experts, discuss reasons for—and a key risk of—going back.

item.description: Looking for a biopharma job in Cambridge? Check out the BioSpace list of six companies hiring life sciences professionals like you.

item.title: Hiring Outlook: February Brings First YOY Job Increase Since 2022
item.description: Last month, for the first time in nearly four years, average job postings live on BioSpace did not decline year over year. In another encouraging sign, the number of biopharmas letting employees go fell.

item.title: The Next Cambridge? LA Sets Its Sights Higher
item.description: The Los Angeles region is one of California’s fastest-growing life sciences hubs, according to a California Life Sciences sector report. The CEO of BioscienceLA discusses the market’s strengths, challenges and where it might be five years from now.

item.description: Follow along as BioSpace tracks job cuts and restructuring initiatives.
